name: protection_fire_efficiency_curve
description: Test 1: GetStationEfficiency of a locally funded fire station with no lot and no strike is curve8D(f x 100) x 0.01 with the shipped curve (0,10)(50,25)(75,45)(90,75)(100,100)(120,110): f 0.5 -> 25 -> 0.25 (0x3E800000), 0 -> 10 -> 10 x 0.01f = 0.099999994 (0x3DCCCCCC, not 0.1f: protection 6.2 PR3 makes 100 and 0.01 float32 constants; bit-exact expectations added with that answer), 1.1f -> 105 -> 1.05f (0x3F866666), 1.2f -> 110 -> 1.1f (0x3F8CCCCD), the shipped maximum 1.1999999 -> 1.1f; curve(75) = 45, curve(95) = 75 + 5 x 2.5 = 87.5. With an empty exemplar the code default (0,0)(100,100)(120,110) gives 0.5 at f 0.5. Values computed with an independent numpy float32 model of the curve rule of foundations 4.3 and checked against the spec's numbers and bit patterns.
